title: Returns & exchanges
sub: One case per exchange: the reason, the money box, the new parcel and the piece coming back on one card. The window counts from the courier's delivered mark.

charge.SET: Customer pays the second delivery (own size choice)
charge.NOT_SET: Exchange charge not set yet — nothing is collected

case.never: Approving books a new parcel at the money box's amount. No money moves here and no refund is paid; a wallet credit is only a request after QC.
case.erpAgain: Send to the ERP again (Stock › ERP documents)

act.waiveNote: Waive {amount}: the rider then collects {cod}. Why (logged)

start.title: Start an exchange
start.sub: For a delivered order: type its number, pick the piece and the reason; the tiers show what may be offered.
start.note: These are the only pieces the rules allow, strictly in order.
start.none: Nothing in stock in that size in any allowed tier.
start.rootCause: Why the wrong item went out
start.received: SKU really coming back (if not the one ordered)

closed.NOT_DELIVERED: Not delivered yet — an exchange opens once the parcel is with the customer.
closed.UNKNOWN: The delivered mark is missing — check the courier first.
closed.EXCLUDED: This piece's category is not exchanged.
closed.NOT_COVERED: The exchange rule does not cover this piece.
closed.REASON: The exchange rule does not take this reason.
closed.LIMIT: This piece has no exchanges left.
closed.OPEN: This piece already has an exchange open.

start.oneTrip: One-trip size swap: the rider brings the new size and takes the old one back in the same trip (charge {amount})
start.reship: Re-ship after a try-on: linked to the refused order; the refused parcel coming back is the pick-up, the old piece covers only what was paid, and the refusal no longer counts against him.

errors.EXCHANGE_CLOSED: No exchange now: the policy is off, the window has passed or the parcel is not delivered.
errors.NOT_EXCHANGEABLE: This piece cannot be exchanged (category or reason).
errors.EXCHANGE_LIMIT: This piece has no exchanges left, or one is already open.
errors.NOT_OFFERED: That piece is not among the ones offered.
errors.PHOTO_REQUIRED: Our mistake needs a photo here.
errors.EXCHANGE_STATE: The exchange is not at that step any more. The page shows it as it is now.
errors.OUT_OF_STOCK: The new piece is no longer free.
errors.REASON_REQUIRED: Pick a reason (and a root cause for a wrong item).
errors.STALE: Someone changed this case just now. The page shows it as it is now.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Something is missing or not valid.
errors.RETURN_STATE: The parcel is not at that step any more. The page shows it as it is now.
errors.SKU_MISMATCH: The SKU scanned is not the one expected. Tick "not the SKU expected" and write a note — or scan again.
errors.UNKNOWN_SKU: That SKU is not a piece of this shop. Scan again or type it from the label.
errors.QC_INCOMPLETE: Check every piece of the parcel, each once, then save.
errors.LOSS_REASON_REQUIRED: A piece that is not sellable needs its reason (and a photo when the setting asks).
errors.NOT_SAME_PIECE: Only another size of the same product and colour.
errors.PRICE_DIFFERS: That size costs another price now. An exchange never changes a price.
errors.NOTHING_CHANGED: That is the size already chosen.
errors.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: The new parcel is booked with the courier; the size cannot change now.
errors.EDIT_CLOSED: The new parcel can no longer be changed.
errors.RETURN_CLOSED: No return now: the policy (no returns after receipt), the window has passed, or the parcel is not with the customer.
errors.RETURN_LIMIT: These pieces are already coming back (a return or an open exchange).
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This button was already used for another request. Reload the page.
errors.server-error: That did not work. Try again.
errors.ERP_MODEL: This step does not run on this store's ERP model.
errors.LEGACY_OFF: This old step is switched off for this store.
errors.ERP_REFUSED: The ERP did not take it.
errors.ERP_UNAVAILABLE: The ERP cannot be reached now. Nothing changed; try again in a little while.
errors.EXCHANGE_WAITING: Not enough of the new piece is free in the ERP now. Regular orders come first, so the exchange waits.
errors.HANDBACK_STATE: The list is not at this step now. Open the page again.
errors.NOT_EXPECTED: This parcel is not expected back, or it is already on a list.
errors.NOT_IN_ERP: This order was not sent to the ERP on the new model.

qc.title: Receive & QC
qc.sub: Phone-first: find the parcel → check each piece → sellable or not → save. A typed SKU works when the scanner is off.
qc.photoNeeded: A photo is needed for a piece that is not sellable.
qc.otherSku: This is not the SKU expected — record what really came back
qc.saveHint: Saving also marks the parcel as received.
qc.d4: Sellable pieces go to the ERP; stock rises only when the ERP confirms. Not-sellable pieces are a loss in the shop’s records and are never sent to ERP stock.
qc.done: Checked — nothing left to do here.
qc.closeEarly: Why close it before QC (required) — e.g. the courier lost it

switch.title: Another size
switch.sub: Same piece and colour, same price. Pick a size to switch; the stock is checked first.
switch.none: No other size at this price.

retStart.title: Or a return
retStart.sub: Only when the policy allows it; otherwise an exchange is the way back.
retStart.none: These pieces are already coming back (a return or an open exchange).
retStart.paid: Paid for these pieces: {amount} — noted only; no money is paid back here

closed.POLICY: No returns after receipt — the shop's policy. An exchange is the way back (Settings › Orders › Return handling for our own mistakes).
closed.NOT_DELIVERED: Not delivered yet — a return after receipt opens once the parcel is with the customer.
closed.UNKNOWN: The delivered mark is missing — check the courier first.

refused.title: Refused parcels
refused.sub: Parcels refused at the door, and the refused-parcel list a person decides. Nothing here blocks an order.
refused.parcelsNote: A refusal the shop caused (late, wrong item, damaged) is marked and never counted against the customer. A size that did not fit at the door is a try-on: it is not counted either.
refused.listOn: On · a number is proposed after {n} counted refusals
refused.listOff: Off · the owner can switch it on in Settings → Orders → Refused-parcel list

empty.PROPOSED: No number waiting for a decision.

refused.noteRemove: Why is this number taken off? (required)
refused.never: The list only tells the ad audiences which numbers to leave out (once a person put them there). It never blocks an order, turns Cash on Delivery off or asks for an advance.

handback.title: Hand-back desk
handback.sub: The courier hands back returned parcels: scan each one, count the pieces, write a short note, then send the list to the ERP. The owner checks every piece in the ERP; the shop never decides if a piece can be sold again.
handback.v5: This store still uses the old ERP model. Returned parcels are received and checked on Receive & QC until the switch-over.
handback.noOpen: No open list. Start one when a courier brings parcels back.
handback.code: Scan the consignment (showroom: the order number)
handback.noteHint: Needed when the count is not what is expected
handback.noteNeeded: Write a short note: the count is not what is expected, or the parcel is not expected.
handback.unexpected: This parcel is not expected — take it anyway
handback.closeHint: After closing, no parcel can be added. The list goes at once; if the ERP is down it is sent again by itself.
handback.resend: Send refused parcels on a new list
handback.never: Nothing here moves money. The owner decides every returned piece in the ERP.

erp.title: ERP returns
erp.sub: What happened to every returned parcel after the hand-back: on Hold, in the ERP's Return stock, approved or declined by the owner in the ERP. Read-only here.
erp.v5: This store still uses the old ERP model. Returns are received and checked on Receive & QC until the switch-over.
erp.noLink: The store is not linked to its ERP yet. This page fills in once the first return list is sent.
erp.never: Read-only: the owner decides every returned piece in the ERP. A wrong decision is put right in the ERP, then pulled here.

empty.handedBack: No parcel handed back yet. The hand-back desk sends them.
empty.returnStock: No piece waiting for the owner's check.
empty.exchanges: No exchange through the ERP yet.

state.RETURNED_WAITING_CHECK: Old piece back, waiting for check

erp.checkWithin: The owner checks each piece within {n} days of the hand-back.

timeline.title: Parcel {id}
timeline.none: Nothing recorded for this parcel yet.
timeline.notFound: No parcel with that number in this store.
timeline.deskClaim: Count differed at the desk: claim started

compare.title: Check against the ERP
compare.none: Not compared yet. It runs every night, or pull now.
compare.failed: The ERP could not be asked
compare.pull: Pull from the ERP and compare again
compare.never: A difference is fixed by pulling from the ERP again, never by editing a number.

losses.title: What returns cost us
losses.sub: Declined pieces at the price paid to the ERP, exchanges billed to us, the courier's charge on returned parcels, and money not collected.

claims.title: Courier claims
claims.sub: Pieces missing or damaged that the courier may owe for. Send them to the courier.
claims.desk: Counts that differed at the desk

more.title: More options
more.runAt: Nightly compare with the ERP at
more.where: These are changed in Settings → Orders.
